One original 280m Blender sea worm with organic nacre shields, fins, photophores and vertex color variation. One loaded body supplies two arc-length appearances: the first curved breach 5m toward the launch pad from the jump midpoint, and a submerged diagonal left-to-right crossing over the second trench bend. The underwater route has a fixed world-space heading and gentle 8m undulation, never following the road around its turn. Its whole-body crossing is staged at route2140m, 210m earlier than the previous alongside swim, with a speed-scaled clock including boost acceleration. Existing foam and pooled spray are used only for the first breach. No added animal, meshes, maps or passes. Pause, reset/navigation, reduced motion, loading failure and owned disposal remain supported.
